protocol.name: MagicBokeh Target-guided Point-Focus / Depth-Medoid B
protocol.authorization: User explicitly selected B after40-frame three-candidate control/visual review on2026-09-30; disclose target-region predicted-depth assisted point selection
protocol.target: Designated object from metadata; visible alpha=object alpha times all nearer-layer transmittances
protocol.click_region: Visible alpha>0.9, then>0.5, then>0 if empty; largest8-connected component; boundaries zero padded
protocol.point: Pixel of native PNG8 depth nearest safe-region median; ties greatest exact Euclidean boundary distance, then row-major
protocol.model_input_permission: RGB and one target-guided click; visible GT target alpha and native predicted depth assist point selection outside model. No GT numeric depth, mask, alpha or hidden RGB fed to generator
protocol.depth: Official DAdepth.pth / ViT-L from RGB; infer_image input_size518, per-image minmax plus1e-8, truncate toPNG8
protocol.focus: Native predicted PNG8 depth at selected point /255, not region median scalar
protocol.K: Manifest K unchanged; abs(native_depth-focus)*K/32; focus mask<=0.1
protocol.generator: Unchanged FP16 official model;512x512 tiles, stride256, original overlap reconstruction and PIL/AdaIN output
protocol.temporal: Independent frame inference, no propagation/smoothing; same semantic object selected perframe
protocol.RNG: Seed42+25*manifest_scene_index+frame_index immediately before six native tile calls; preflight/full and worker order independent
protocol.visibility_inventory: 5000/5000 have safe visible alpha>0.9; zero unavailable frames; no semantic instance changes
protocol.preflight_reuse: Forty B outputs and native depth conditions reused; exact generator replay checked before full run
protocol.quality_scope: Paired public-proxy reproduction development; GT-guided control permission disclosed; no claim of same-geometry or automatic autofocus comparison
protocol.failure_policy: Keep K32 partial-target defocus and native depth variation; no K/gamma/threshold search or depth replacement

fvd.preprocessing: cdfvd video preprocess: short side 256 + center crop; byte conversion; public VideoMAE resize 224; [0,1]
fvd.adaptation: n_fake='full' prevents default 2048 repeated samples; PNG decoding replaces video decoding
fvd.temporal_note: public tubelet_size=2: 25 input frames yield 12 temporal tokens; final unmatched frame is unused
fvd.covariance: public FeatureStats population covariance / scipy sqrtm

vfid.preprocessing: public RGB ImageSequenceDataset: ToTensor, Resize 224x224, then [-1,1]
vfid.adaptation: per-scene datasets avoid public flattened-folder cross-scene clips and broken VideoDataset indices
vfid.covariance: public calculate_fid / numpy.cov ddof=1 / scipy sqrtm

limits: Public-proxy reproduction development, not held-out or official author test set.
GT visible target alpha and own predicted depth assist the selected click; input permissions differ from external-geometry methods.
K is nominal manifest K with nativeK/32; no physical CoC equivalence claimed.
Native depth variation and partial-target defocus are retained; no threshold or strength compensation.
Frame-wise model, no temporal smoothing or propagation; separated preflight frames do not prove no flicker.
